title: Transition-Window Cut Schedule for Prior Authorization Deadline Extensions
content:
**Schedule rule.** The transition-window cut of a member-requested deadline extension counts the days from the member's plan coverage start date to the day of the request: from the seventy-sixth day on, three days are cut; from the forty-sixth through the seventy-fifth day, one day is cut; through the forty-fifth day, nothing is cut.

The coverage start date is the one on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership. The count runs in calendar days: the day after the coverage start date is day 1, and the day of the request is the last day counted. The days are subtracted once from the days a member-requested deadline extension adds, before the limits of one day and of the class's most review-extension days are applied. The rule belongs to Prior Authorization review time.

## Cut schedule

| Day count on the day of the request | Days cut |
|---|---|
| 45 or fewer | 0 |
| 46 through 75 | 1 |
| 76 or more | 3 |

## Boundary days (hypothetical dates)

For a hypothetical coverage start date of 1 January in a year that is not a leap year:

| Request made on | Day count | Days cut |
|---|---|---|
| 15 February | 45 | 0 |
| 16 February | 46 | 1 |
| 17 March | 75 | 1 |
| 18 March | 76 | 3 |
